note: pre-registration: pools fixed before vetting and training; use the vetted file for results
method: pool = sha256(seed:video_id) mapped to [0,1) with cut points 0.40 / 0.70; videos that also have a knock clip forced to P3

use.P1: simulator background texture only (high-passed residual, ambient, mic character); never firing
use.P2: real base clips for additive injection (knock, valve tick): training + validation
use.P3: held-out real test: false alarms per hour, demo replay; never touched by training or the simulator
use.knock_check: AudioSet 'Engine knocking' clips both raters agreed are detonation: weak out-of-domain check, never training
